source_facts.quantization: offline FP8 checkpoint for vLLM, stored as compressed-tensors
source_facts.release_status: preliminary upstream checkpoint; subject to change
source_facts.cuda_runtime_note: RedHatAI card validates on B200 and says to run on vLLM main; RTX 6000 Ada requires local boot, tokenizer canary, and runtime validation before production claims

upstream_example.quantization: model_config compressed-tensors; do not pass --quantization fp8

project_runtime_policy.policy_reason: RTX 6000 Ada conservative start for RedHatAI preliminary FP8 checkpoint; upstream example uses 96K context on B200/vLLM main, so this platform keeps 16K seq=1 until local tokenizer, boot, quality, latency, and soak validation pass
project_runtime_policy.chat_content_contract: OpenAI chat content string or content parts with text and image_url
project_runtime_policy.image_url_policy_reason: avoid arbitrary server-side URL fetch by default; validate MIME, decoded image bytes, and image dimensions; external HTTPS image fetch should be enabled only behind an egress policy
project_runtime_policy.request_parameter_policy: bounded allowlist in configs/model_serving.yaml; unknown chat fields rejected at Gateway
